definitionOfFull: Full means comprehensive project architecture and broad statutory inventory for the defined Culross study scope. It does not claim that every asset has a complete building history, condition survey or verified building footprint.
knownLimitations: The listed-building coordinate index is a practical snapshot and must be refreshed against HES.
Official conservation-area, scheduled-monument, designed-landscape and listed-building boundary polygons are imported live rather than approximated.
Historic-map candidates require exact sheet identification, licensing and service URLs.
Many individual domestic buildings still require detailed date transcription from their official HES records.
The wider parish inventory extends beyond the compact historic burgh and must be filterable by study-area section.
A building-by-building survival and integrity survey is required before treating the heat map as a definitive historic-character assessment.
